tests.name: seven services are healthy; DB roles and immutable identity are enforced
agency-a: real OIDC login, fixed organization, protected logout
agency-b: real OIDC login, fixed organization, protected logout
employer-x: real OIDC login, fixed organization, protected logout
employer-y: real OIDC login, fixed organization, protected logout
same browser changes agency A to B after logout
unregistered user sees a recoverable HTML error and no new session
disabled user invalidates a session and refuses login
disabled organization invalidates a session and refuses login
nonce mismatch refuses authentication
expired attempt refuses authentication
tampered encrypted verifier refuses authentication
missing or foreign browser binding refuses authentication
wrong state and malformed query are rejected without consuming a valid attempt
callback reuse is rejected and cannot switch the existing identity
expired session clears stale UI on focus and offers login
logout clears the other tab and discards a delayed identity response
API restart preserves the database session
identity and logout network errors are visible and recoverable
mobile layout, keyboard login and logout work
M2 RLS fails closed without context and filters actual runtime queries
M2 direct IDs, role changes and missing sessions cannot disclose other organizations
M2 input bounds, CSRF, UUID, unknown fields and mutation key are enforced
M2 job lifecycle, canonical idempotency, concurrent versions and cursor filtering
M2 candidate update/archive is immutable, scoped and replay-safe
M2 browser job registration, publication, search/save and forbidden detail
M2 browser candidate form, conflict preserves input, archive and mobile keyboard
M2 job advisory lock times out safely and leaves the version unchanged
M2 browser retries a lost creation response with the same key and no duplicate
M2 expired browser session retains only the unsaved form and refuses writes
M3 static and tagged PDFs pass; all forbidden policy fixtures fail closed
M3 authentication CSRF input limits and original document RLS deny foreign access
M3 duplicate uploads share one reservation and replay after candidate archive
M3 live lease is 202 and expired pending survives actual API restart
M3 recovery checks existing final bytes and refuses wrong hash without replacement
M3 obsolete lease cannot finalize and archive wins candidate document lock order
M3 browser upload download rejection and expired pending recovery work on desktop and mobile
M3 kill during inspection preserves the same document and missing storage rejects safely
M3 actual PDF service isolation internal authentication and concurrency bounds
R1 valid PDF and native Sheets XLSX stay AV pending and cannot be downloaded or submitted
R1 extension MIME content kinds and CSRF fail closed, correct octet stream is inspected
R1 upload outcomes preserve processing, seven-day failures, mismatch and terminal expiry tombstones

R1 synthetic completed-check fixture proves snapshot format, RLS, block precedence and share revocation
R1 browser XLSX upload displays AV pending without a download link on desktop and mobile
M4 draft hidden from employers; submit atomically freezes candidate job and selected PDF
M4 direct IDs and runtime RLS isolate all six new tables without privileged shared reads
M4 input CSRF role and failed submissions leave no snapshots events or idempotency residue
M4 same-key submit and transitions replay once even after sharing is revoked
M4 E_SHARED permits submitted screening rejected and hired; terminal revoke preserves placement
M4 status table rejects invalid transitions and duplicate active recommendations
M4 concurrent versions serialize selection against revoke without restoring shared content
M4 job lock orders close before submit and rejects stale candidate or archived submissions
M4 list pagination filters and active share revocation never expose candidate metadata
